name: brain-voice
description: Registers your self-hosted Voice Brain MCP server (deployed from tools/voice-brain) in Claude Code. Only needed when `claude mcp list` does not already show it.

voice_brain_url.title: Voice Brain MCP URL
voice_brain_url.description: The full URL printed by tools/voice-brain/setup.sh — https://<host>/mcp/<secret>. The secret path IS the credential; it is stored in your OS keychain, never in settings.json.
